subject.title: [F6] Zero-duration spans indicate missing duration instrumentation

question: Should trajectory JSONL rows gain a measured duration/span contract, and which reported event types should become lifecycle spans versus remain point events?
rationale: Current code and docs expose trajectory rows as events; adding duration/start/end fields changes exported diagnostic schema and may overlap with but not be replaced by the OTel latency work.

options.title: Define measured trajectory spans
options.body: Keep this issue open and approve a focused design that adds `durationMs` or start/end fields for real lifecycle operations with tests and docs.

options.title: Keep trajectory event-only
options.body: Leave trajectory JSONL as a point-event support bundle and route latency measurement to OTel diagnostics, with docs clarifying that distinction.

options.title: Split runtime and transcript timing
options.body: Measure runtime lifecycle events first and track transcript-derived tool call/result timing as a separate schema decision.

recommendation.title: Define measured trajectory spans
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and approve a focused design that adds `durationMs` or start/end fields for real lifecycle operations with tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and release provenance route the trajectory schema/runtime code most directly to this contributor, with related OTel input from bek91 as adjacent context.
